notes: P3-OPT-050: MAP-P3 parameter sweep — vary ONLY entry_threshold (= indicators.bb_k).
Single variable change: bb_k 2.0 -> 2.5. All other params identical to baseline.

Mechanic: bb_k widens the Bollinger envelope from +/-2.0*std to +/-2.5*std, so entries require a more extreme deviation from the 20-period SMA before triggering. Lower-frequency, potentially higher-conviction mean-reversion signals.

Hypothesis: stricter entry threshold should reduce trade count and noise, possibly improving win-rate and Sharpe if the strategy is signal-rich but quality-poor at bb_k=2.0; conversely it may starve the strategy of signals and damage Sharpe if 2.0 was already near the optimal boundary.
